'''''Star Wars: Blood Ties''''' is a comic miniseries by [[Dark Horse Comics]] focusing on [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. It was followed by a sequel miniseries, ''[[Star Wars: Blood Ties: Boba Fett is Dead]]''.
